note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸科目，老師的模板沒有這一列；不列入期中考範圍。
note.en: An extension account added by the site; the teacher's template has no such line and it is outside the mid-term scope.

definition.zh-TW: 貨款以外、還沒付的各種款項，例如應付的水電費或薪資。它是流動負債，變動時經過間接法的其他負債增加列。
definition.en: Unpaid amounts other than trade payables, such as utilities or wages still to be paid. A current liability whose movement passes through the increase in other liabilities line of the indirect method.
